description: Drive the agent browser from the shell with penguin browser — the desktop app's built-in browser or the user's own Chrome, whichever the user chose — to read pages as simplified HTML or text, act with JavaScript and trusted clicks and typing, and extract structured data such as orders or search results, signed in with the user's own accounts.
description_zh: 用 penguin browser 在 shell 中驱动 Agent 浏览器——桌面应用的内置浏览器或用户自己的 Chrome，由用户选择——以简化 HTML 或纯文本读取页面，用 JavaScript 以及可信的点击与输入操作页面，提取订单、搜索结果等结构化数据；登录用的是用户自己的账号。
short_description: Read pages, act and extract data in the built-in browser or your Chrome.
short_description_zh: 在内置浏览器或你的 Chrome 中读取页面、执行操作、提取数据。

quick_start.prompt: Open news.ycombinator.com in the agent browser and list the top five stories as a table of title, points and link.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 在 Agent 浏览器中打开 news.ycombinator.com，把排名前五的帖子整理成表格：标题、分数和链接。
